name: National Heroes' Day
rule: Holidays (Public General) Act, Schedule item 6: the third Monday in October

name: Christmas Day
rule: Listed among Jamaica's public holidays by the Consulate General of Jamaica, Toronto (not in the Act's Schedule)

name: Boxing Day
rule: Holidays (Public General) Act, Schedule item 7: the day after Christmas Day (Christmas 2026 is a Friday)

name: New Year's Day
rule: Holidays (Public General) Act, Schedule item 1 (moves to 2 January only if 1 January is a Sunday; 2027 is a Friday)

name: Ash Wednesday
rule: Holidays (Public General) Act, Schedule item 2; Easter Sunday 2027 = 28 March, Ash Wednesday = 46 days before

name: Good Friday
rule: Listed among Jamaica's public holidays by the Consulate General of Jamaica, Toronto (not in the Act's Schedule); Easter Sunday 2027 = 28 March

name: Easter Monday
rule: Holidays (Public General) Act, Schedule item 3; Easter Sunday 2027 = 28 March

name: National Labour Day
rule: Holidays (Public General) Act, Schedule item 4: 23 May, or the following Monday if 23 May is a Saturday or Sunday (23 May 2027 is a Sunday)

name: Emancipation Day
rule: Holidays (Public General) Act, Schedule item 5(a): 1 August, or the following Monday if 1 August is a Sunday (1 August 2027 is a Sunday)

name: Independence Day
rule: Holidays (Public General) Act, Schedule item 5(b): 6 August (a Friday in 2027)

name: National Heroes' Day
rule: Holidays (Public General) Act, Schedule item 6: the third Monday in October

name: Christmas Day
rule: Listed among Jamaica's public holidays by the Consulate General of Jamaica, Toronto (not in the Act's Schedule)

name: Boxing Day
rule: Holidays (Public General) Act, Schedule item 7: the day after Christmas Day; the Schedule moves it only when Christmas Day is a Sunday (Christmas 2027 is a Saturday, so the statutory date is Sunday 26 December). The Minister may appoint a different observance day by order.
